From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumen Health — Prelaunch conditioning & stewardship assignment

Hi team,

Quick handoff for Lumen Health (Enterprise, healthcare payer). Deal signed yesterday; committed go‑live target is 2026‑12‑08. Key points:

- Contract: 12 month, Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Redwood Optimize add‑on.
- Expected initial throughput: 12M tokens / month (spiky weekdays).
- Data flows: PII will be redacted client‑side; they require SOC2 in place and monthly audit log exports.
- Integration: Two APIs — chat/generation and embeddings for search. Tech contact: Amanda Cho (amanda.cho@lumenhealth.com). Procurement contact copied separately.

Attachments: Lumen_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), tech_requirements_matrix.xlsx (integration fields).

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Assign primary CS owner + backup.
2) Confirm target date for a 90‑minute technical kickoff week of 11/29 — prefer 11/30 or 12/1.
3) Validate infra requirements with Vivek (reserved capacity sizing, VPC peering cadence).
4) Coordinate a prelaunch run (staging) 2 weeks before go‑live.

Monica — can you own the activation? If not, please nominate who and confirm availability for the kickoff window above.

Thanks — I’ll remain in the thread to support contracting questions.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0123

--
Attachment stubs: Lumen_SOW_v1.pdf, tech_requirements_matrix.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Lumen Health — Prelaunch conditioning & stewardship assignment

Thanks Ben — appreciate the concise handoff.

Monica, can you pick this up as primary CS owner? If you’re overloaded, propose a backup but we need a named owner by EOD Friday (11/20).

Operational notes from my side:
- Risk: Their token profile is heavy on long contexts for embeddings + chat. We should consider early quantization test for embeddings to reduce memory pressure.
- Billing: They asked for a monthly reporting cadence and a single invoice to procurement. Finance will need the PO number before go‑live — Ben, please loop procurement once PO is confirmed.

Vivek — can you confirm whether the Dedicated pool we discussed (2x A40 equiv) can be reserved for them on 12/08 and whether we need any quota adjustments now?

If Monica confirms ownership, I’ll prepare the internal MOP (minutes, owners, escalation path) and share a short readiness checklist.

Jonas
Jonas Weber | Director, Customer Success Operations
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Lumen Health — Prelaunch conditioning & stewardship assignment

I’ll take primary ownership for activation and post‑go‑live adoption. Backup: Vivek will act as technical steward for infra and will own staging run sign‑off.

Proposed kickoff slots (pick one):
- Tue 11/30 10:00–11:30 PT — tech + product alignment + SOW review
- Wed 12/01 09:00–10:30 PT — alternate if 11/30 conflicts

Prelaunch checklist (short):
- Confirm PO and billing contact (Ben)
- Send staging account credentials and test dataset (customer to provide minimal sample)
- Validate VPC peering and egress rules (Vivek)
- SOW final review and signature plan (Ben)
- Success metrics: 90‑day adoption goals; define 3 initial templates for embeddings search relevance tests

Ben — please share the latest PO status and any procurement timelines. Amanda — looping the customer below: can you confirm which kickoff slot works and whether procurement needs any additional documents?

I’ll draft a short runbook and owners matrix once the slot is confirmed.

–Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the handoff team — appreciated. 11/30 10:00 PT works best for us.

A couple of immediate items from procurement:
- PO number will be issued by 11/24. They requested the final SOW and billing contact for invoicing.
- Our security team would like the audit log export cadence clarified (monthly, S3 push preferred) and a copy of your SOC2 report. Can you confirm where to upload those?

Technical note: We can provide a 10k anonymized sample dataset for staging by 11/23. Please confirm the upload method (SFTP or secure share).
